verdict.rationale: Lago documents explicit API versioning policy stating v1 clients should tolerate additive changes (new fields, enums, endpoints, optional fields, webhook event types), and publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for typed client generation, showing a concrete, documented versioning/compatibility approach. Missing for 10: no explicit sunset/deprecation timeline or historical changelog of breaking changes, and no independent corroboration of the policy being honored in practice.
